Version 0.1.1 of governed-agents

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates or modifications to functionality, documentation, or metadata.

Initial release of governed-agents: deterministic verification and reputation scoring for AI sub-agents.

- Prevents hallucinated success with 4 code gates (files, tests, lint, AST) and a 3-layer pipeline (Structural → Grounding → LLM Council) for open-ended tasks.
- EMA-based reputation scoring adapts supervision level to agent reliability.
- Supports deterministic (coding) and council (open-ended) verification modes.
- Includes pre-configured task-type profiles and CLI/script install.
- Pure Python stdlib; no external dependencies.
